sync.title: Settings Sync
sync.intro: Back up your settings to your own WebDAV server (Nextcloud, Synology, and the like) and keep them consistent across machines. Settings only — feeds and articles are not included; use OPML import/export under Data for feeds.
sync.enabledDesc: When off, the address and password are kept — nothing is uploaded or downloaded
sync.urlDesc: Must start with https:// and point at the WebDAV root (Nextcloud looks like https://<host>/remote.php/dav/files/<user>/)
sync.passwordDesc: Nextcloud with two-factor enabled requires an app password rather than your login password
sync.passwordKeep: Saved — leave blank to keep it
sync.pathNote: Settings are stored at {{path}} (Clip creates the clip/ level itself)
sync.securityNote: The password is encrypted in the local database, with the key file kept alongside it. That protects the database file if it leaves your machine (a backup, a file you send someone, an accidental upload). Anyone who can read your whole user directory can still recover it — Clip does not use the system keychain.
sync.testSuccess: Connection works — read and write both succeeded
sync.removeDesc: Deletes the server address and password. The backup already on the server is left alone.
sync.upToDate: Up to date with the server

result.conflict: Conflict detected — choose which side to keep below

conflict.title: Sync conflict
conflict.desc: Both machines changed settings, so they cannot be merged automatically. Pick a side to keep — the other side's changes will be overwritten.

sync.syncedItems: Synced: theme, reading typography, language, update interval, notification and accessibility options. Window size and proxy settings stay local to each machine.

cloudBackup.title: Database Cloud Backup
cloudBackup.intro: Save subscriptions, articles, notes, read state, and starred state as versioned database snapshots. This is backup with manual restore, not automatic database merging across machines.
cloudBackup.enabledDesc: Create a new snapshot on the selected schedule; manual backup remains available
cloudBackup.intervalDesc: Failures wait at least one hour before retrying to avoid consuming server request quotas
cloudBackup.retentionDesc: Delete older snapshots after a new version is published
cloudBackup.saveError: Could not save cloud backup settings
cloudBackup.pathNote: Database snapshots are stored under {{path}}, with a separate file for every backup.
cloudBackup.securityNote: Snapshots exclude local settings, proxy details, and the WebDAV password. Article content and notes are stored on your WebDAV server; this version does not add application-level encryption to snapshot contents.
cloudBackup.unavailable: Save a WebDAV address and password above before enabling or running database cloud backup.
cloudBackup.historyEmpty: There are no database snapshots on the server yet.
cloudBackup.restoreWarning: Restarting will replace current subscriptions and articles. A local rollback copy is created first.
cloudBackup.restoreSuccess: The backup is staged. Restart Clip to complete the restore. A rollback copy of the current database is at: {{path}}
